records.name: Chicagon / Chicaugon Falls
records.title: State-owned waterfall; no proven continuous public approach
records.summary: Michigan DNR land records put Chicagon Falls on a dedicated 47.8-acre state forest parcel. An official forest-management report for the surrounding Chicagon Creek compartment warns that private landowners control almost all vehicle access to that compartment. County tourism guides describe a signed Raymer/Dave's Camp trail but report washouts and passing private camps. None of this establishes today's lawful parking or a continuous public trail to the waterfall.
records.guidance: The waterfall's state parcel is verified, but do NOT navigate to the GIS point, cross private camps or assume Raymer/Dave's Camp Road is passable and public to its end. A signed, legal lot-to-view path needs verification before a visitor guide can be indexed.
records.locationNotes: Michigan GIS #12 at 46.134032,-88.452985 agrees broadly with other geographic catalogs around 46.1336,-88.4535; a separate tourism listing reports 46.1089,-88.4903, a materially different location. The latter must not be substituted as parking or falls position.
records.reviewLimitations: 2019/2020-era DNR compartment 12139 concerns the surrounding Chicagon Creek forest area, not a survey or specific trail deed for falls #12. County road commission's 2018 seasonal-restriction list includes Long Lake Road but does not show Raymer/Dave's Camp in that list; absence proves neither private ownership nor closure. State MGF geographic road-name data near the falls identifies Long Lake Road but not a named Raymer segment, which also is not a legal road determination. Exact right-of-way, parking and current passability remain unverified.
records.nextEvidence: Obtain an authoritative legal public right-of-way or DNR access map from Long Lake Road through Raymer/Dave's Camp to the state parcel, including permission at private camps, a designated turnout and footpath; until then no vehicle waypoint or public trail line.

records.title: Jumbo Falls: public trail, but maps disagree by nearly a kilometre
records.summary: The USDA Forest Service Ottawa National Forest 2015 Recreation Opportunity Guide names Jumbo Falls and directs visitors from M-28 west of Kenton through Golden Glow Road, Forest Road 4589 and 4589-B past Jumbo Pit to an established falls trail. Its official coordinate is 46.457753,-88.912228. A regional trail list describes a short, roughly 0.1-mile level trail from the named parking to Jumbo Falls, but a specialist natural falls point is 46.44963,-88.91278, 904 metres from the agency brochure point; Michigan GIS #29 at 46.453006,-88.912138 lies between them, 528 metres from agency and 379 metres from specialist. We cannot identify which coordinate is trailhead, fall, other cascade or an outdated record from currently published evidence. Historic park/trail road descriptions do NOT establish road passability, a correct map pin, new signage or a precise current legal parking turnout.
records.guidance: The U.S. Forest Service has an established named Jumbo Falls Trail via Golden Glow Road and FR4589-B. Do not use a raw mapped falls pin as parking or an off-road route until its physical location and current trailhead are reconciled.
records.reviewLimitations: Obtain current U.S. Forest Service GIS trailhead and Jumbo Falls geomarker/route polyline or other reliable surveyed source distinguishing the 2015 agency coordinates from the specialist falls point, establish certified designated visitor parking and the ~0.1-mile trail's correct physical destination, plus present FR4589-B road/trail restrictions. Do not route to any of the three coordinates before reconciling.

records.guidance: Do not tell visitors to pass the gate, cross the river to bypass private land or take the GIS coordinates as a car destination. records.name: Au Train Falls
records.title: Au Train Falls: federal hydro license terminated; visitor access still unverified
records.summary: FERC's December 29, 2025 final order (Docket P-10856-141, 193 FERC ¶61,242) TERMINATED the Au Train Hydroelectric Project license by implied surrender, effective that day's close of business, with existing facilities LEFT IN PLACE. FERC's record cites high-hazard dam classification, inadequate spillway remediation, licensee UP Hydro's bankruptcy and loss of property control. In 2025 foreclosure, Stephenson Bank acquired 18/22 project parcels and later sold those 18 to D. Charles Trust Investments, LLC (including powerhouse and surrounding project buffer), but individual tourist parking and falls-side parcel title/right of way are not mapped by this order. Michigan EGLE now holds state dam-safety jurisdiction; termination neither orders immediate dam removal nor establishes all waterfall visitor routes closed or open. Munising tourism describes two separate upper/lower falls visitor stops near utility gates, but that older guidance does not establish October 2026 parking, public gate entry, walkway, flow conditions or new property owner consent.
records.guidance: Do not treat either of the old Power Dam Road upper/lower tourism lots as current authorized parking; do not pass power plant or dam gates without posted public authorization. The federal license ended in 2025; that does NOT automatically mean the waterfall is closed or dam removed. No river crossing or dam-outlet approach is recommended.
records.reviewLimitations: Original 2025 report about a proposed license surrender is superseded by FERC's December 29 FINAL termination order. The FERC order ends federal licensing, not every existing owner property right or recreational activity. Ownership changes within project boundary do not map the exact upper/lower parking parcels.
records.nextEvidence: Current 2026 rights owner/EGLE source explicitly documenting a lawful publicly accessible upper and/or lower falls visitor parking area and foot corridor on utility land; verify separate two-view routes, gate policy, dam safety/flow notices and legal parking. FERC final license termination itself neither closes all visits nor authorizes tourist access.
